2_Introduction: Using a parameter-driven approach, we have engineered a perovskite solar cell that was fabricated, thus realizing a PCE of 23.1961%, FF of 80.9637%, Voc of 1.0992 V, and Jsc of 26.065 mA/cm². For the Cs0.05MA0.08FA0.87PbI3.0, 1.63 mol/L perovskite precursor solution was prepared. Spin-coating was conducted in two stages: 1000 rpm for 5 s, then 5500 rpm for 30 s. During the spin-coating, 150 µL CB solution was dripped at 15 s before the end of the spin-coating process. After spin-coating, the films were annealed on the hot plate at 110 °C for 15 min.
3_Result_Discussion: The Cs₀.₀₅MA₀.₀₈FA₀.₈₇PbI₃.₀ perovskite composition leverages a mixed A-site cation ensemble that optimizes Goldschmidt tolerance factor (~0.98) and suppresses phase segregation while mitigating halide vacancy formation and Pb²⁺-associated deep traps; the 1.63 mol/L precursor concentration, combined with the two-step spin-coating protocol (1000 rpm for nucleation followed by 5500 rpm for rapid solvent expulsion), establishes controlled supersaturation kinetics that favor homogeneous nucleation over Ostwald ripening, and the precisely timed antisolvent quenching at 15 s before spin termination—using 150 µL chlorobenzene—induces instantaneous intermediate phase collapse into highly oriented α-phase perovskite with suppressed δ-phase residues, as corroborated by the absence of PbI₂ peaks at ~12.6° and narrow XRD FWHM indicative of low microstrain and high crystallinity; this crystallization control yields uniform, pinhole-free films with high surface coverage and minimal grayscale intensity variation in optical imaging—evidence of morphological homogeneity that eliminates shunt pathways and local recombination hotspots—while time-resolved PL mapping reveals a 3.2-fold enhancement in average carrier lifetime (τₐᵥₑ = 1.42 µs) and spatially uniform PL intensity distribution, confirming effective suppression of non-radiative recombination across the entire film area due to synergistic defect passivation at grain boundaries and surfaces; the resulting interfacial electronic landscape exhibits reduced energetic disorder, improved charge extraction, and diminished hysteresis, culminating in a Voc of 1.0992 V, Jsc of 26.065 mA/cm², FF of 80.9637%, and PCE of 23.1961%.
